description: Transfer files, sync the clipboard and manage files between a PC and phones or Macs over the local network
notes: This is the vendor's portable 'green' build: it unpacks into the Scoop app directory and runs without an installer or administrator rights.

The archive ships helper batch files ('添加右健菜单支持.bat', '添加开机启动.bat' and their removal counterparts) that register an Explorer context-menu shell extension under HKCR and a run-at-login entry under HKCU. They are not executed during install; run them yourself from the app directory if you want those integrations.
Requires the .NET Framework 4.0 runtime, which ships with Windows 10 and 11.
